phase_prompt.summary: Subterranean sanctum with integrated advanced tech
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic, tactile depiction of a subterranean sanctum beneath an ancient Ethiopian temple, featuring basalt walls etched with bioluminescent glyphs that glow azure, a central levitating obelisk of obsidian and copper alloy pulsing with unseen energy, towering bronze pillars adorned with hieroglyphic circuitry and pale green runes, a floor of polished stone and translucent crystal mosaic reflecting ambient light, all bathed in a soft, eerie glow with a faint static hum, blending ancient ritualistic architecture with incomprehensible advanced technology.
